settings.title: Shipping Information
settings.subtitle: Fast, reliable shipping to 195 countries worldwide.
settings.domestic_text:
Orders ship within 1-2 business days from our US warehouse. Free shipping on orders over $150.

Standard delivery typically arrives within 3-7 business days depending on your location.
settings.international_text:
We ship to 195 countries via FedEx International Connect Plus. International orders typically arrive within 7–14 business days.

Duties and taxes are charged at checkout. Your order clears customs with nothing further to pay — no surprise bill at the door.

Customs handling does vary by country. In the rare case duties aren't collected at checkout, your local carrier or customs office may ask for them on delivery.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Domestic orders ship within 1-2 business days and typically arrive within 3-7 business days. International orders arrive within 7-14 business days depending on destination.

settings.question: Do I get a tracking number?
settings.answer: Yes. You'll receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information once your order ships.

settings.question: What about duties and taxes for international orders?
settings.answer: They're charged at checkout, so your order arrives with nothing further to pay. Customs handling varies by country, so in rare cases a local office may still ask for them on delivery. Two exceptions: international returns — the customer covers return shipping; and international warranty replacements — the customer covers shipping and duties on the replacement.

settings.question: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
settings.answer: Contact us immediately after placing your order. We can update the shipping address before the order ships (within 1-2 business days of placement).
